units.source_text: 出殡前，我身穿礼服，手持念珠和团扇，同来自摄津的表兄搭伴，前往吊唁。

en.t: Before the funeral procession, I put on formal mourning clothes, held my prayer beads and a fan, and went with my cousin from Settsu to pay our condolences.

units.source_text: 我年轻，但比起表兄来，我一举一动显得格外肃穆，合乎礼仪，驾轻就熟地扮演了角色。

en.t: I was young, but compared with my cousin, my every movement seemed especially solemn and proper, and I played my part with practiced ease.

units.source_text: 表兄吃惊地望着我，学习我的动作。

en.t: My cousin looked at me in surprise and copied my movements.

units.source_text: 本家的五六位堂兄齐聚一起，没有必要让他们看见我那副沉下来的脸。

en.t: Five or six cousins from the main family were gathered together, and there was no need to let them see my downcast face.
